title: List the four shipped client packages the client/ group README omits
task:
Problem: packages/client/README.md:7-44 is the group's package table, and packages/client/README.md:46 says every child reference owns its own contract, so the table is the family's index. `ls -d packages/client/*/` lists 39 packages; the table names 35 of them. Missing: `ui-deliverables/`, `ui-directory-picker-browse/`, `ui-directory-picker-native/`, and `ui-message-feedback/` (each has a README.md and a package.json in the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` family; `comm -23 <(ls -d packages/client/*/ | xargs -n1 basename | sort) <(grep -o '](\([a-z0-9-]*\)/README.md)' packages/client/README.md | sed 's/](\(.*\)\/README.md)/\1/' | sort -u)` prints exactly those four). The row at packages/client/README.md:36 labels `ui-permission-presets/` as `ui-permission/`, a directory that does not exist, while its link already points at `ui-permission-presets/README.md`. packages/client/README.zh.md carries the same table with the same four omissions and the same label at README.zh.md:36. The sibling family index packages/host/README.md lists every host package; this one falls short of the standard it links.

Required: add one row per missing package, with a one-clause purpose taken from that package's README opening paragraph (ui-deliverables, ui-directory-picker-browse, ui-directory-picker-native, ui-message-feedback), placed beside the rows they relate to (the picker rows near `ui-workspace/`, feedback near `ui-conversation/`, deliverables near `ui-trajectory/`); correct the label at README.md:36 to `ui-permission-presets/`; mirror every change in README.zh.md with the purpose clauses translated under docs/i18n/terminology.md; re-record with `pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write packages/client/README.md`; run `pnpm run doc-sync`.

Constraints: documentation only; do not reorder the existing rows or change their purpose text; do not touch the child READMEs; mechanical index maintenance under the Agent Note exemption. The queue's mandatory coverage run names dsh-client-ui-message-feedback, one of the packages the table gains; it guards that package, not this edit, and passes before and after.

acceptance.run: grep -q '](ui-deliverables/README.md)' packages/client/README.md && grep -q '](ui-directory-picker-browse/README.md)' packages/client/README.md && grep -q '](ui-directory-picker-native/README.md)' packages/client/README.md && grep -q '](ui-message-feedback/README.md)' packages/client/README.md
